markdown_content: # CLO 2025.1 New Features Overview This document details the key new features and improvements introduced in CLO 2025.1, including Simless Blocking, Denim Wet Wash presets, 3D Pen enhancements, Clopap fabric digitization, Zipper Style management, AI function updates, UI and 2D/3D workflow improvements, animation upgrades, Closet enhancements, and more. It covers technical explanations, procedures, and usage instructions to optimize design workflows and fabric realism in CLO. --- ## Simless Blocking: Pattern Color and Texture Application Without Cutting This section explains the Simless Blocking feature for applying colors and textures to patterns by dividing areas without cutting or sewing, enhancing design flexibility especially for knitwear and mixed materials. ### Creating Simless Blocking Lines - Located under the Internal Polygon Tool in the 2D toolbar. - Simless Blocking lines are drawn by clicking on the pattern outline (cannot start inside the pattern). - Lines behave like internal lines — can be straight, multiple points, or curves. - Holding Shift enables 45-degree angle guidelines for precise vertical, horizontal, or angled lines. - For symmetric patterns, lines drawn on one side auto-create mirrored lines on the other. - Asymmetric designs can be created by widening the centerline. - Curved lines can be created by clicking and dragging (Bezier curves) or pressing Ctrl while clicking. - Incorrect points can be deleted via Backspace or Delete. - Line creation finishes by double-clicking on the pattern outline or existing Simless Blocking lines. - Simless Blocking lines are always dotted and highlighted sky blue in 2D; they appear similar to internal lines in 3D. ### Modifying Simless Blocking Lines - Use the Edit Pattern Tool to move points or ingredients. - Adjust curves using the Bezier Curve Handle or Edit Curve Point Tool. - Points can be deleted with the delete key. - Add straight or curve points freely. - Convert line segments between straight and curve points. - Change line values numerically as in pattern editing. ### Creating Multiple Simless Blocking Lines at Intervals - Right-click a Simless Blocking line and select "Offset as Simless Block Line." - Enter the number of offsets and interval distance. - Useful for striped designs or repeated material separation. ### Applying Fabrics to Simless Block Areas - Drag and drop fabrics from the Object Browser to a Simless Block area in 2D or 3D. - Or use the Transform Pattern tool to select an area and assign fabric. - Fabric density and texture can be adjusted independently. - Bond, skiving, geometry, simulation properties, and pattern arrangement apply to the entire pattern. - Symmetric patterns require manual fabric application on each side for independent design. - Modifying the base pattern outline automatically updates Simless Blocking lines in real time, improving efficiency. - Existing internal or baseline lines can be converted to Simless Blocking lines via the Trace tool. - Simless Blocking lines support topstitch and puckering edits. - Graphics applied to patterns are unaffected by Simless Blocking lines and render naturally. - Simless Blocking lines do not appear in Print Layout outputs. - Opening files from versions prior to 2025.1 converts Simless Blocking lines to normal base lines. --- ## Denim Wet Wash Preset: Realistic Denim Fabric Effects This section covers the Denim material type and the Wet Wash preset system for simulating realistic denim washing effects through parameter adjustments. ### Denim Material Setup - Denim material type added in CLO 2025.1. - Select fabric style, change Material Type to Denim in Property Editor. - Wet Process option appears, offering multiple wash types. ### Available Wet Wash Types - **Unwashed:** Raw denim look with matte base texture. - **Rinse Wash:** Uniform, soft tone maintaining original fabric color. - **Enzyme Wash:** Slight lightening for natural worn look. - **Stone Wash:** Uses stone effects for matte, dull fabric with strong bright/dark contrast. - **Acid Wash:** Strong contrast with marbled dirt effect. - **Bleach Wash:** Brightens denim via bleaching; intensity adjustable. - **Ozone Wash:** Subtle, uniform fading. - **Custom Wash:** Applies user-provided maps for unique washing effects. ### Adjusting Wet Wash Properties - Changing Wet Process type updates parameters and wash maps automatically. - **Fading Intensity:** Controls color contrast and wear effect. - **Blend Mode:** Options like Normal, Multiply, Screen, Overlay affect how wash blends with base color. Overlay is most natural for denim. - **Absorbance:** Controls spread and softness of washing effect edges. - **Cycle Duration:** Simulates washing time, affecting overall brightness. - **Seam Puckering (Seam Evasion):** Requires pre-applied puckering on seams; adjusts seam line visibility and realism. ### Examples - Stone wash preset applied instantly adds vintage stone washing effect. - Bleach wash with adjustable bleach concentration and blend mode (e.g., Soft Light for smooth blending). - Manipulating absorbance and seam puckering refines the denim’s worn look. --- ## 3D Pen Avatar Tool Enhancements: Direct 3D Sketching in Space This section details improvements to the 3D Pen Avatar tool, enabling designers to sketch directly on and beyond the avatar surface for complex, three-dimensional garment design. ### Using the 3D Pen Avatar Tool - Select from 3D toolbar. - Click points on avatar surface or press **P** to extend points freely into 3D space beyond the avatar. - Guide points with color-coded XYZ axes appear: Blue (Z), Red (X), Green (Y). - Hold **Ctrl** to create curves while drawing lines. - Hold **Shift** to snap lines to 45-degree angles in 3D space for precise drawing. - Press **D** to toggle real-time distance display between cursor and avatar. ### Creating 3D Patterns - After drawing lines, press **P** to return drawing to avatar surface. - Close the shape by clicking the start point. - Use the 3D Pen tool’s "Flatten" option to convert the closed 3D line into a 3D pattern. - Press Enter to finalize the creation. ### Benefits - Enables fast, intuitive creation of complex 3D garment elements. - Supports more natural, freeform 3D design workflows directly on the avatar. --- ## Clopap: AI-Based Digital Fabric Creation and Application Clopap is a new fabric digitization tool integrated into CLO 2025.1 that leverages AI and scanner hardware for high-quality digital fabric map and physical property creation. ### Launching Clopap - Access via Clopap icon in Fabric tab of Object Browser. - Also accessible by modifying existing fabric maps or through the Fabric menu in the main menu. ### Fabric Creation Workflow 1. **Map Tab:** -
